design_rules: CED topic order is preserved across the route.
A topic may span multiple planned loci, but a later topic may not be taught before an earlier CED topic is established.
Each locus must have a visible physical layout, a distinct scientific job, and a causal transition to the next locus.
Mnemonic actors and story events are deferred to the narrative phase. F2 locks only spatial and scientific architecture.
Equations, graphs, tables, particulate models, and other representations must match the F0C component plan.
No production journey is added to journeys.json until its narrative and scene records pass the later narrative gate.

journeys.scientific_mission: Move from measurable sample mass to particle amount, isotope evidence, fixed compound composition, and variable mixture composition.
journeys.route_orientation: One-way industrial analysis line from receiving scale to mixture audit station.

loci.name: Mass Receiving Scale
loci.scientific_job: Establish molar mass, mass-to-mole conversion, and dimensional-analysis unit cancellation.

loci.name: Particle Counting Vault
loci.scientific_job: Connect moles to constituent particles with the Avogadro constant.

loci.name: Isotope Spectrum Bay
loci.scientific_job: Read a single-element mass spectrum, distinguish isotope mass from abundance, and calculate a weighted average atomic mass.

loci.name: Pure-Compound Analysis Bench
loci.scientific_job: Connect fixed composition, percent composition, and empirical formula to pure compounds.

loci.name: Mixture Purity Station
loci.scientific_job: Contrast variable mixtures with fixed pure substances and use elemental composition to reason about purity and mixture composition.

journeys.scientific_mission: Build the electron-structure model, then test that model against photoelectron-spectroscopy evidence.
journeys.route_orientation: Vertical observatory from nucleus floor through electron levels to a spectrum theater at the top.

loci.name: Nucleus Floor
loci.scientific_job: Establish charged atomic components and the Coulombic interaction used throughout the unit.

loci.name: Shell and Subshell Stairwell
loci.scientific_job: Separate shells, subshells, core electrons, and valence electrons spatially.

loci.name: Ground-State Configuration Board
loci.scientific_job: Construct ground-state electron configurations with the Aufbau principle while preserving AP exclusions.

loci.name: Ion Configuration Lift
loci.scientific_job: Track electron gain/loss for ions and connect electron removal to nuclear attraction.

loci.name: PES Spectrum Theater
loci.scientific_job: Use PES peak positions and relative intensities to test and infer electron configurations and binding-energy differences.

journeys.scientific_mission: Use one electrostatic and electron-structure model to explain periodic patterns instead of memorizing isolated trend arrows.
journeys.route_orientation: A periodic-table-shaped tower with a horizontal period corridor and vertical group elevator.

loci.name: Periodicity Grid Lobby
loci.scientific_job: Connect recurring periodic properties to recurring ground-state electron configurations.

loci.name: Attraction Control Room
loci.scientific_job: Coordinate nuclear charge, shielding, electron repulsion, and distance as the causal model for trends.

loci.name: Radius Corridor
loci.scientific_job: Explain neutral atomic-radius trends from the causal model.

loci.name: Ionization Stair
loci.scientific_job: Explain first and successive ionization energies, including large jumps and local deviations.

loci.name: Affinity and Electronegativity Gallery
loci.scientific_job: Treat electron affinity and electronegativity as distinct properties explained by electron structure.

loci.name: Ionic Radius Balcony
loci.scientific_job: Compare parent atoms, cations, anions, and isoelectronic species by attraction and electron occupancy.

loci.name: Prediction Deck
loci.scientific_job: Use periodic location to predict unknown properties while enforcing the Aufbau-exception scope guard.

journeys.scientific_mission: Turn periodic valence patterns into predictions about reactivity, typical ionic charge, analogous compounds, and charge-balanced ionic formulas.
journeys.route_orientation: Assembly hall moving from valence inspection to group-pattern racks and a final charge-balance station.

loci.name: Valence Inspection Gate
loci.scientific_job: Connect valence-electron configuration to reactivity and bond formation.

loci.name: Group Pattern Racks
loci.scientific_job: Recognize why elements in one group often form analogous compounds.

loci.name: Ion Charge Workshop
loci.scientific_job: Predict typical main-group ionic charges from periodic position and electron gain/loss.

loci.name: Formula Balance Scale
loci.scientific_job: Balance total cation and anion charge to form neutral ionic formulas without moving into Unit 2 lattice-property depth.
